scope: Paired synthetic development comparison; twelve classes, no test or real reception accuracy claim.
features: Both arms N,4,1,4096 float32. Channels0/1 unchanged I/Q. iq_zero: channels2/3 exactly zero. Candidate channel2=abs(IQ); channel3=angle(z[t]*conj(z[t-1]))/pi, first sample zero; zero product has phase zero. Float64 feature calculation then float32. No centering, frequency correction, learned scaling or augmentation.
architecture: Existing experimental tf-compatible Harper port, six SE gains fixed2, first Conv1d expanded2->4. Shared original IQ kernels/bias and all remaining tensors from saved pretraining initial_state.pt for seeds2081/2082; new channel kernels exactly zero in both arms. Identical parameter shapes/counts; baseline has inactive extra kernels. No random reinitialization of common tensors. Not an isolated test of envelope versus phase; joint feature treatment.

data.selection: Recompute original complete-group selection, require exact same source IDs, labels, SNR and conditions as saved selection. Train/validation source IDs and conditions disjoint. Existing validation is reused development data.

controls: Fresh optimizer each arm, paired initial tensors, exact paired minibatch permutations, fixed100 epochs/5300 updates, no scheduler/clipping/early stopping. No historic FP32 tolerance changes. Log deterministic settings and environment; no claim of cross-backend bit identity.
checkpoint_selection: Strict minimum mean validation cross entropy after epochs1..100; earliest tie. Preserve best and last full model/optimizer/RNG checkpoints and every epoch history. No historical trained weights continued.
primary_decision: Candidate advances directionally only if selected-checkpoint validation mean CE strictly lower AND twelve-class macro-F1 strictly higher in BOTH seeds. Otherwise mixed/inconclusive. Never select only best seed.
secondary: Per-class recall, FSK-family mean recall, high-SNR>=15dB per-class metrics, accuracy, final-epoch metrics, epoch durations and feature preprocessing time. No independent significance claim.
failure: Stop on nonfinite input/loss/gradient/validation or provenance mismatch. Keep incomplete outputs and failure report; no automatic restart/resume.
limits: Redundant deterministic features change inductive bias/optimization, not information content. Baseline extra weights inactive; equal nominal parameters/updates are not equal effective capacity or wall time. No current Coral compatibility or drone recognition proof. Existing historical FP32 parity gate remains not passed.
